item.title: Adani Enterprises’ AMG Media Networks to acquire remaining stake in IANS
item.description: New Delhi: Adani Enterprises has informed stock exchanges that its wholly owned subsidiary, AMG Media Networks (AMNL), has entered into an agreement to acquire the remaining stake in IANS India, completing its ownership of the news agency. In a regulatory disclosure dated January 22, the company said AMNL executed a share purchase agreement on January 21, 2026, to acquire the balance shareholding in IANS. item.title: NXTFACE taps Women’s T20 League moment with Jemimah Rodrigues on Jio Hotstar
item.description: New Delhi: Gen Z-focused skincare brand NXTFACE has launched a new advertising campaign featuring Indian cricketer Jemimah Rodrigues, timed with the ongoing Women’s T20 League. item.title: Amazon set to cut thousands of corporate jobs next week as part of workforce reduction plan
item.description: New Delhi: Amazon is planning a second round of corporate job reductions next week, as part of an ongoing effort to reduce its workforce by roughly 30,000 positions, according to Reuters. In October, the company cut around 14,000 white-collar roles, approximately half of the total target first reported by Reuters.
